verdict.rationale: Spending caps and usage alerts are a fair question for a usage-billed cloud browser platform, but the evidence pack never mentions budget limits, credit caps, or billing alerts. The webhooks in docs-19 are not shown to emit usage or billing events. The monitoring alerts in docs-11 concern product breakage, not spend, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set a spending cap or usage alert so proxy/credit consumption doesn't silently blow past my budget
